changelog:
Plex posters and Plex playback.

**Plex**
- Posters now load. The app had the server's credential but only ever held it in
  memory, and only put it there when you added the source or tapped Refresh — so
  on an ordinary launch it had nothing to send. The catalog still listed
  perfectly, because that comes from the phone's own database, while every poster
  request went out unauthenticated and was refused. The credential is now read
  back from the stored source, so it is there whenever the app is.
- Playing a Plex title was asking the server for the wrong thing entirely: the
  item's description rather than its video file. The player was handed a page of
  text and failed the way an unplayable codec fails, which is why it looked like
  a video problem. It now asks for the file.
- A title whose file the server no longer has opens its detail screen instead of
  offering a Play that cannot work.

**Proven, and how far**
- A Plex film now plays end to end: cold-started app, poster loaded, video on
  screen. That was against a stand-in server built to behave like Plex, on an
  emulator -- not against your own server, which is the part only you can test.
  It says the app's own wiring is right; it does not say a given server will
  play.

Known limits: multi-view, picture-in-picture, DVR and recording are not in this
build. Catch-up still has not been tested against a real provider archive.
